title: Homestyle Irish Pak Choi Hash
description: A savory, kid-friendly Irish dish featuring pak choi, double-fried potatoes and a glassy-jelly finish. This recipe is easy to make and can be cooked in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: 1 pound pak choi
ingredients.notes: any type of pak choi works, separated into leaves and stems

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons oil
ingredients.notes: olive or vegetable oil for frying

ingredients.name: 1 onion, chopped
ingredients.notes: any color, but white or yellow work best

ingredients.name: 1 cup chicken broth
ingredients.notes: you can also use vegetable broth for a vegetarian option

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the separated pak choi leaves and stems and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the chicken broth and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the liquid has thickened into a glassy jelly.
Stir in the flour to thicken the jelly, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pak choy hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
